```python
import re

from fractions import Fraction

n = 30
matrix = []

for line in sys.stdin:
    if "=" not in line or not re.search(r"x\d+", line):
        continue
    lhs, rhs = line.split("=", 1)
    row = [0] * (n + 1)
    for sign, coefficient, index in re.findall(
        r"([+-]?)\s*(?:(\d+)\s*\*\s*)?x(\d+)", lhs
    ):

        row[int(index) - 1] += -value if sign == "-" else value

    matrix.append(row)

assert len(matrix) == n

previous_pivot = 1
for k in range(n - 1):
    pivot_row = next(i for i in range(k, n) if matrix[i][k])
    matrix[k], matrix[pivot_row] = matrix[pivot_row], matrix[k]
    pivot = matrix[k][k]

    for i in range(k + 1, n):
        entry = matrix[i][k]
        for j in range(k + 1, n + 1):
            numerator = pivot * matrix[i][j] - entry * matrix[k][j]
            quotient, remainder = divmod(numerator, previous_pivot)
            assert remainder == 0
            matrix[i][j] = quotient
        matrix[i][k] = 0
    previous_pivot = pivot

    )
    solution[i] = remainder / matrix[i][i]

assert all(value.denominator == 1 for value in solution)
print(json.dumps({"answer": [value.numerator for value in solution]}))
```
